title: T-44 local Orama full-text/BM25 retrieval benchmark
decision: SELECT ORAMA FULL-TEXT (BM25F, hyphen-split tokenizer): recovers every expected source on a local, deterministic, cost-free baseline. Default Orama English tokenizer keeps hyphenated compounds as single tokens (reproducible empty results for "out"/"stitch"); the tuned tokenizer resolves this while remaining pure full-text. Hybrid/vector would impose external embeddings (a declared non-goal) with no demonstrated benefit; rejected per STOP gate.

invariants.detail: every hit.document.source equals the corpus source for hit.id
all returned sources equal corpus/indexed source
full-text (hyphen-split tokenizer) recovered every expected source; vector/hybrid NOT required
retrieval path is local Orama full-text; no embeddings, vectors, hybrid mode, external API, or credentials

sourcePreserving: every recovered document maps back to a corpus rule with verbatim id/source; no session/DNA/credential fields in schema or query path
